subject: Important Update: Changes to Our Customer Support Hours
body: Dear valued customers, we wanted to inform you that we are making adjustments to our customer support hours starting next week. Our new hours will be from 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM Monday to Friday. We believe this change will allow us to serve you better and provide more efficient assistance. If you have any concerns or need help outside these hours, please don't hesitate to reach out to us. Thank you for your understanding and continued support.
